name: mcp-pack
description: MCP servers with no CLI or API equivalent, kept deliberately small: Proxyman (controls a running local macOS app — its CLI covers config, rules and certs but live traffic inspection is MCP-only), Recraft (vector SVG) and Iconify (icon search). Removed as redundant rather than broken: Neon and Grafana are reachable with their own skills plus a key from Infisical; Unsplash duplicates the claude.ai connector; Playwright is better driven by the playwright-cli skill; Mapbox docs and DevKit went unused and DevKit was never authenticated. Higgsfield and Nano-Banana needed HF_API_KEY/HF_SECRET that were never set, so every session opened with two failing servers — use the higgsfield-cli skill. Enable at user scope so all sessions get them.
